title: IS IT SPILL PROOF? Lenovo Thinkpad P50 review + spill damage test
summary: Louis Rossmann reviews the Lenovo ThinkPad P50, covering build, thermals and throttling, then spills liquid on it to test the keyboard drainage and spill protection.
why: Cited as evidence that ThinkPads survive spills thanks to their drainage design, often with timestamps for the spill test.

quote.text: the waterproofing is kind of incredible
